description: Match invoices to stablecoin transfers by memo first, then exact amount and asset inside the invoice window. Names what is left over in both directions: invoices nobody paid, money nobody invoiced, invoices paid twice. A duplicate is counted once, never twice. Do NOT use as proof of who the payer was.

invoices.description: id, amount, asset, created_at; optional due_at, payee, memo.

transactions.description: tx_hash, amount, asset, timestamp; optional to, memo.

name: reconcile_books
title: Reconcile invoices against transfers
